mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO air_quality ( sido_name, station_name, data_time, pm10_value, pm25_value, khai_value ) VALUES
(#{item.sidoName}, #{item.stationName}, #{item.dataTime}, #{item.pm10Value}, #{item.pm25Value}, #{item.khaiValue})
mapper.select: SELECT data_time AS dataTime, ROUND(AVG(CAST(pm10_value AS DECIMAL(10,1))), 1) AS pm10Avg FROM air_quality WHERE pm10_value REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' AND data_time LIKE CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), '%') AND sido_name = #{sido} GROUP BY data_time ORDER BY data_time
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO AIR_QUALITY ( sido_name, station_name, data_time, pm10_value, pm25_value, khai_value ) VALUES
(#{r.sidoName}, #{r.stationName}, #{r.dataTime}, #{r.pm10Value}, #{r.pm25Value}, #{r.khaiValue})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pm10_value = VALUES(pm10_value), pm25_value = VALUES(pm25_value), khai_value = VALUES(khai_value)
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.data_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') AS dataTime, ROUND(AVG(CAST(NULLIF(a.pm10_value, '-') AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) AS pm10Avg FROM AIR_QUALITY a WHERE a.sido_name = #{sido} AND a.data_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(a.data_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') ORDER BY dataTime ASC
